title: Make the existing natural paper proof genuinely natural and same fresh governed case
summary: Enforce genuine natural proof in loop-prod-tel-002 probe by requiring a fresh governed case (dev-paper-release-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}), fail closed on absent/mismatched case checksum/plan/binding/version/state, eliminate invented IDs and default versions, require explicit non-empty market input lineage (rejecting bare raw_symbol alone), and anchor approved artifact checksum/version from registry entries when missing in persona provisioning. In natural mode the wrapper script never invokes hosted_lifecycle_stimulus. Controlled-stimulus mode remains available and clearly labelled.
